'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Barbados]]-flagged [[bulk carrier]] {{MV|True Confidence||2}} is hit by a [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] [[ballistic missile]] in the [[Red Sea]], killing three crew members and injuring six others. The vessel is subsequently abandoned. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/three-missing-bulk-carrier-off-yemen-after-incident-reported-shipping-source-2024-03-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/03/06/politics/crew-members-killed-houthi-attack/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[Mexican Navy]] [[Eurocopter AS565 Panther|Eurocopter Panther]] helicopter crashes in the [[Pacific Ocean]], killing three crew members and leaving two others missing. Three others are rescued. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-navy-helicopter-crash-three-dead-0fe55181d263c439bff822a11ec2df39 (AP)]
*Five people are killed and two other passengers are injured after a [[private aviation|private aircraft]] crashes shortly after takeoff from [[Diapaga Airport]] in [[Diapaga Department]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2024/03/07/five-killed-in-a-private-plane-crash-in-eastern-burkina-faso/ (Africanews)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–Russia relations]]
**[[Armenia]] formally requests that [[Russia]] withdraws its [[Russian Armed Forces|troops]] from [[Zvartnots International Airport]] near [[Yerevan]], saying that the airport must be served solely by the [[Armenian Border Guard]]. The airport has hosted a Russian military presence since 1992. [https://www.rferl.org/a/armenia-russian-border-guards-remove-yerevan-airport/32850687.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Ottawa stabbing|Killing of the Wickramasinghe family]]
**A Sri Lankan family, of four children and their mother, are killed with the father injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a residence in the suburb of [[Barrhaven]], in [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]]. A young man is arrested. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/ottawa/ottawa-homicide-barrhaven-berrigan-drive-arrest-1.7136366 (CBOT-DT)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Pakistan]] unanimously rules that former leader [[Zulfikar Ali Bhutto]] was denied a [[fair trial]] before his execution by hanging in April 1979. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/6/pakistan-top-court-says-ex-pm-bhutto-hanged-in-1979-was-denied-fair-trial (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Technological University of Guadalajara attack]]
**Three people are killed and another one is injured in a stabbing attack at the Technological University of Guadalajara in [[Guadalajara]], [[Mexico]]. <ref>https://mexiconewsdaily.com/news/3-women-dead-1-suspect-arrested-after-stabbings-in-guadalajara/</ref>

**[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]]

****Former [[Governor of South Carolina|South Carolina governor]] and [[United States Ambassador to the United Nations|U.S. Ambassador]] [[Nikki Haley]] ends her presidential campaign.
